title: AssetRef
description: Reference to a static file served by the backend under /assets/. Paths are content addressed and immutable, so the client may cache forever. GLB files are standard glTF 2.0 (meters, Y up); the viewer maps them to build space with one fixed transform: scale 1000, rotate +90 deg about X.

role.description: What the file is for. model is the full detail GLB, model_lod1 the decimated one, thumbnail a square PNG (256 px), render a large PNG placeholder of the assembled object.

url.description: Path relative to the server origin, beginning with /assets/, for example /assets/parts/3f9a2c/model.glb. Absolute https URLs are allowed for mock mode.

status.description: ready: fetchable now. pending: will be produced; a later event carries the ready ref. missing: will not exist; show the placeholder.

nodes.description: GLB node names that are addressable (for recolor and highlight).

node_colors.description: Base colour each GLB node was written with (hex), e.g. a lens node's tint.

origin.description: design: a file from the open design repo. generated: produced by this build (case, autorouted board, compiled binary). catalog: a part library file.
